skill.summary: Provides web content fetching, caching, document OCR, real-time messaging, group chats, file transfers, and webhook integrations via Prismer Cloud APIs.

latestVersion.changelog:
Prismer Cloud Agent Skill 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides detailed setup instructions for agent registration and API key binding via the Prismer CLI.
- Supports IM features: direct/group messaging, file transfer (simple and multipart), and social bindings (e.g., Telegram).
- Includes real-time options for message delivery: polling, webhook, WebSocket, and SSE.
- Enables advanced context loading/search and global caching for LLM integrations.
- Adds document parsing (OCR) from PDF/images to Markdown, with sync and async modes.
